[#observed-alert-rule]
= Observed alert rule

Rule that turns what the collector sees into a notification: a new issue, a regression, an error rate above a threshold, a source that stops sending or a collector that drops events. Each rule has its channel (log, webhook or email) and avoids repeated notices with its cooldown.

== Dónde se encuentra

No aparece en el menú: se llega desde otra entidad.

== Campos

[cols="2,2,1,5",options="header"]
|===
|Campo |Tipo |Obligatorio |Detalles

|Nombre
|Texto
|Sí
|Name shown in the notices.

|detonante
|Opción de una lista
|Sí
|What fires the rule: new-issue, regression, error-rate (errors per minute above threshold during window-minutes), source-silent (no event during window-minutes), collector-dropping (the queue discards events), slo-burn (an objective spends its error budget too fast), probe-down (a probe fails its checks), tls-expiring (the certificate of a probe expires soon), anomaly (traffic, errors or latency of an origin out of what is usual for that hour) or disk-high (the store uses at least threshold % of max-disk-mb; 80 without threshold). Valores posibles: «nueva emisión», «regresión», «tasa de error», «fuente-silenciosa», «caída-del-colector», «combustión lenta», «sonda hacia abajo», «tls-a-punto-de-caducar», «anomalía», «disco-alto». Valor inicial: «nueva emisión».

|de origen único
|Observed source (referencia)
|No
|Origin the rule watches; empty for every origin.

|Nivel mínimo
|Opción de una lista
|Sí
|For new-issue and regression: minimum level of the issue. Valores posibles: «error», «fatal (calificador)». Valor inicial: «error».

|umbral
|Número entero
|Sí
|For error-rate: errors per minute (average of the window) that fire the rule. Valor inicial: «10».

|minutos de margen
|Número entero
|Sí
|For error-rate and source-silent: minutes of the evaluation window. Valor inicial: «5».

|canal
|Opción de una lista
|Sí
|Where the notice goes: log (a warning in the log of the application), webhook (POST JSON, compatible with Slack and Teams) or email (needs multitenant-notification). Valores posibles: «registro», «webhook», «correo electrónico». Valor inicial: «registro».

|Objetivo
|Texto
|No
|Comma-separated emails, or the URL of the webhook.

|Enfriamiento: 12 minutos
|Número entero
|Sí
|Minimum minutes between two notices of the same rule and problem. Valor inicial: «30».

|silenciado hasta el
|Fecha y hora
|No
|The rule does not notify until this moment (maintenance windows); the alerts are still recorded.

|habilitado
|Sí / no
|Sí
|A disabled rule is not evaluated. Valor inicial: «false». Lo calcula la aplicación: no se edita.
